exports.name: ContentSwap
exports.description:
Cross-fades two contents in place. The inactive one is `hidden` (correct without CSS or JavaScript);
with `press.css` the swap fades and slides (opacity only under reduced motion).
exports.signature: ({ active, children, confirm, live, reducedMotion, className, ref, ...rest }: ContentSwapProps): Element

props.name: active
props.description: Show `confirm` instead of `children` (e.g. `copied`).

props.name: children
props.description: Content while idle (e.g. "Copy").

props.name: confirm
props.description: Content while active (e.g. "Copied ✓").

props.name: live
props.description: Announce the new content politely when it changes (default `"off"`).

exports.name: LongPress
exports.description:
P11 `<LongPress>`: hold to activate, with a progress layer (`press.css`). Usually `asChild` on your own

props.description: Keyboard: hold Space/Enter for the duration (`"hold"`, default) or activate on one press (`"press"`).

props.name: moveTolerance

exports.name: NumberTick
